items.titleOriginal: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
items.summary: استضافت وزارة العلوم وتكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات الكورية و NVIDIA منتدى شراكة الشركات الناشئة MSIT - NVIDIA AI في COEX. ممثلون من وزارة العلوم وتكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات و NVIDI
items.summaryOriginal: Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX. Representatives from the Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA met with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors. NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2, with additional investments […]
